spacing.zh-Hans: 以 4px 为基准的阶梯，编号等于像素数除以 4。每个数值只做一件事，页面里不要用阶梯以外的数值。
spacing.en-US: A scale on a 4px base; the id is the pixel value divided by 4. Each value has one job, and a page should not use values outside the scale.

radius.zh-Hans: 嵌套时，内层圆角 = 外层圆角 − 两层之间的间距，最小为 0，这样两条弧线看起来是平行的。
radius.en-US: When rounded shapes nest, inner radius = outer radius minus the gap between them (never below 0), so the two curves stay parallel.

elevation.zh-Hans: 浅色模式用阴影表现高度。深色模式里阴影几乎看不见，所以加深阴影，同时叠一圈很淡的白色描边来分层。
elevation.en-US: Light mode shows height with shadow. In dark mode shadows are almost invisible, so shadows get stronger and a faint white ring is added to separate layers.

status.zh-Hans: 所有数值都是我们自己的提案，没有对照任何参考应用测量，也没有在原生界面里验证。
status.en-US: Every value is our own proposal: not measured against any reference app and not verified in a native UI.

use.zh-Hans: 无间距。
use.en-US: No space.

use.zh-Hans: 图标和文字之间的缝隙，最紧凑的内边距。
use.en-US: The gap between an icon and its label; the tightest padding.

use.zh-Hans: 同一组元素之间的默认间距，小控件的内边距。
use.en-US: Default gap inside a group of related elements; padding for small controls.

use.zh-Hans: 紧凑列表项、表单标签和输入框之间的距离。
use.en-US: Compact list items and the distance between a form label and its input.

use.zh-Hans: 默认内边距：卡片、对话框、页面两侧的留白。
use.en-US: Default padding for cards and dialogs, and the side gutter of a page.

use.zh-Hans: 较宽松的卡片内边距。
use.en-US: Roomier card padding.

use.zh-Hans: 相邻小节之间的间距。
use.en-US: Space between neighbouring subsections.

use.zh-Hans: 分组之间的间距，大卡片的内边距。
use.en-US: Space between groups; padding for large cards.

use.zh-Hans: 页面里相邻区块的间距。
use.en-US: Space between neighbouring blocks on a page.

use.zh-Hans: 大区块之间的间距。
use.en-US: Space between large blocks.

use.zh-Hans: 页面主要区域之间的间距。
use.en-US: Space between the main regions of a page.

use.zh-Hans: 页面首屏上下留白，营销页的区块间距。
use.en-US: Top and bottom space of a hero; block spacing on marketing pages.

use.zh-Hans: 不要圆角：分割线、全宽的条。
use.en-US: No rounding: dividers and full-width bars.

use.zh-Hans: 极小的元素：复选框、徽标里的点。
use.en-US: Very small elements: checkboxes and dots inside badges.

use.zh-Hans: 小标签、代码片段。
use.en-US: Small tags and inline code.

use.zh-Hans: 控件的默认圆角：按钮、输入框、下拉框。
use.en-US: Default for controls: buttons, inputs and selects.

use.zh-Hans: 菜单、提示条、小卡片。
use.en-US: Menus, toasts and small cards.

use.zh-Hans: 卡片、面板。
use.en-US: Cards and panels.

use.zh-Hans: 对话框、大面板、整块区域。
use.en-US: Dialogs, large panels and whole regions.

use.zh-Hans: 胶囊和圆形：标签页的指示条、头像、开关。
use.en-US: Pills and circles: tab indicators, avatars and switches.

use.zh-Hans: 贴在页面上，不浮起：默认的内容区。
use.en-US: Sits on the page, not raised: the default content area.

use.zh-Hans: 轻微浮起：卡片、输入框聚焦前的状态。
use.en-US: Slightly raised: cards and resting inputs.

use.zh-Hans: 浮在内容上方：下拉菜单、弹出层。
use.en-US: Floats above content: dropdowns and popovers.

use.zh-Hans: 盖住页面的一部分：侧边抽屉、命令面板。
use.en-US: Covers part of the page: drawers and command palettes.

use.zh-Hans: 最高一层：对话框，需要用户先处理才能继续。
use.en-US: The top layer: dialogs that need an answer before the user can continue.
